1.d3 e5 2.Nd2.strategy: Heads for the centre with the knight and leaves the f-pawn free, but it shuts in the queen's bishop and cramps development. The move is playable, since that bishop can still come out on b2 after b3, but it is the less natural way to answer Black's central pawn.
1.d3 e5 2.Nd2.name: Valencia Opening
